purpose: Define the acquisition semantics required to reconcile Parallel Quest skill rewards without collapsing distinct reward triggers into a single generic mission relationship.

model.quest_reference: Canonical Parallel Quest number and identity.
model.reward_identity: Canonical skill identity; must resolve to docs/data/skills.json before promotion.
model.trigger_scope: The exact event that can generate the reward, such as clearing the quest, obtaining Ultimate Finish, defeating a named enemy, or satisfying a bonus condition.
model.drop_rate: Optional numerical evidence only when explicitly documented by a sufficiently strong source; otherwise unresolved.
model.first_clear_scope: Tracks whether evidence is specific to first-clear reward slots rather than repeat farming.
model.historical_status: Historical reward structures remain distinct from current mechanics when sources conflict.

rules: Do not convert an Ultimate Finish requirement into a guaranteed item drop unless the evidence explicitly establishes the guarantee.
Do not treat a skill listed in a PQ reward table as proof of the trigger that awards it; route_type and trigger_scope must be separately evidenced.
Do not infer a specific-enemy drop merely because an enemy appears in a PQ.
Do not infer a numerical drop rate from community farming reports, sample sizes, or repeated clears.
Keep first-clear, repeat-clear, and multiplayer reward behavior distinct when evidence distinguishes them.
A skill may have multiple acquisition routes; each route receives its own record rather than overwriting another route.
DLC ownership and the actual PQ unlock requirement are separate fields and must not be conflated.
Unresolved acquisition mechanics remain indexed rather than being silently omitted.

evidence_baseline.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki - Parallel Quests
supports: regular finish and Ultimate Finish are distinct completion stages
some rewards are tied to specific opponents
some rewards are random on Ultimate Finish
multiplayer skill acquisition can propagate to other players
Kaioken is obtained from Parallel Quest 8 with an Ultimate Finish

evidence_baseline.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki - Core Breaker
supports: explicit Ultimate Finish acquisition condition for a later PQ skill

nonclaims: Examples do not establish a universal reward rule for every Parallel Quest.
No numerical skill drop rate is asserted by this model.
No skill is assumed to have a single acquisition route.
The model does not replace the existing PQ reward datasets; it defines the relationship layer needed to reconcile them.
